# Class: `Image_analysis_thread`

Measures per-frame circular regions and builds grayscale and freeze-event tables in a Qt worker thread.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-aux.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_aux.py#L362) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `QThread`.

The `analysis_done` signal reports frame progress, not completion of the whole run. Qt’s `finished` signal triggers result installation. Exceptions are retained in `analysis_error` and `analysis_traceback`; normal in-app analysis passes no output filename and keeps results in memory. Frames outside selected ranges remain `nan` rows in the grayscale table.
